parse_residue_note: Re-asserted this run over the live map. Every span matched by the spine and LNK grammars was stripped with a BALANCED-PAREN LNK stripper. A naive regex under-matches nested calls and manufactures false residue - that happened on the first attempt here and was caught by the control, which is the whole reason the control exists. After stripping, ZERO occurrences of spine[, ->, >> or LNK( survive in any of the 3418 live expression slots. THREE arrow occurrences survive elsewhere, all inside augmentation.key_derivation, which is PROSE BY DESIGN (624 slots, 0 function calls, 0 spine tokens) and is not an expression slot; they are English renderings of a walk such as 'PARENT_KEY_HASH -> CLAIM_ATTRIBUTE_PROPERTIES -> CLAIM_DETAILS.POLICYNO', correctly excluded from both the grammar and the function census. Parser controls: matched a real 3-hop spine and a real LNK, and correctly DECLINED a plain nullif(trim(POLICY_NUMBER)) expression.
function_census_note: RESTORED AND CORRECT. KEY_FUNCTIONS.md now publishes trim 5094 / nullif 5084 / coalesce 1783 / spine[] 2390 / md5 138 / normalise 128 / lnk 51 / upper 19, and all EIGHT reproduce EXACTLY against the live map. The rev-4 disagreement is resolved: the document had been narrowed to resolved_key.expression only (4415 / 4405 / 1704 over 2344) and has been widened back. Three denominators are now in play and all three are right over their own scope - the document says 2843 (slots containing a call or a spine, which is what its generator iterates), this profile parses 3418 live expressions, and the full non-empty string surface is 5162 slots. The NUMERATORS are identical across all three because the extra slots contain ZERO function calls: child_key_components[].value (653), augmentation.child_key_components[].value (466), augmentation.key_derivation (624) and the single child_key_components[].column. collapse_trap_note: 20 (satellite, leg) pairs whose rendered discriminator is ONE value across every view and row that carries it. The previous profile listed 10; all 10 are inside this 20. The extra 10 are legs derived from a source COLUMN that happens to be constant because only one view carries the leg - a weaker signal than a literal constant, but the consequence is the same: the leg cannot separate the instances it is the discriminator for. IDENTICAL at the baseline snapshot, so this is a detector widening, not a bundle change. The spec builder must assert no key expression references any of the 20.
renumbering_ordinal_note: Seven spellings re-enumerated from 00_tables_index.json this run BY SHAPE, not by lookup: PARAM_SEQ, RISK_SERIAL_NO, RISK_SERIAL_NUMBER, SEQUENCE_NUMBER, SERIAL_NO, SRL_NO, SR_NUMBER. ZERO reach a resolved_key expression. SERIAL_NO reaches 11 child-key legs, all on SAT_POLICY_DOCUMENT_DISPATCH. Identical on the rev-3 baseline and the current map. BILL_NO reaches 29 legs and TRIP_NO reaches 12 key expressions; both are ordinal-SHAPED and are deliberately NOT classified as ordinals - see ordinal_shaped_names_not_classified_as_ordinals. The index file is byte-identical to rev 3, so this census cannot have moved.

ordinal_shaped_names_not_classified_as_o.BILL_NO: reaches 29 child-key legs as 'Bill Number'. Classified NOT an ordinal: an invoice/bill number is a document identifier, not a per-parent sequence. UNPROVEN - there is no sample data in this run.
ordinal_shaped_names_not_classified_as_o.TRIP_NO: reaches 12 HUB_RISK_OBJECT key rows as the FALLBACK operand of "'TRIP:' || coalesce(nullif(trim(PNR),''), nullif(trim(TRIP_NO),''))". If TRIP_NO is a per-policy ordinal rather than a global trip identifier, every policy's first trip keys to 'TRIP:1' and the hub merges unrelated trips. UNPROVEN - no sample data. See open item TRIPNO-FALLBACK.

layer_sizing.note: 51 of the 113 casts are for views that are NEVER a row table_name - 45 percent of the cast surface exists for views nothing maps. 36 of those exist only because a hop skips a level. Byte-identical to the baseline snapshot under the same measurement.
layer_sizing.method_delta_note: 115 this run versus 113 in rev 3. My expansion adds EVERY view that is a proper name-prefix of a needed view; rev 3 added only the levels lying between a walk's endpoints. 00_tables_index.json is byte-identical to rev 3, so the view set cannot have changed - this is a definition difference and stage 1 must not read it as a bundle change. Build to 115; the 2 extra casts are ancestors that already have to exist.

bespoke_layers.name: augmented-track alignment shim
bespoke_layers.reason: OPUS travel_dv_dbt already builds 12 SAT_AUG_* satellites. 94 augmentation rows land on 9 concepts OPUS already augments, so they must be emitted INTO the OPUS-named SAT_AUG_<X> with OPUS's src_pk, single-active grain and bare HASHDIFF, extending its payload, rather than into a Maximus-side second satellite. The standard augmented layer builds per-map and cannot express that; declared exception under BUILD_RULES.md 6.5, required by 7.7.

bespoke_layers.name: EAV instance fan-out driven by a literal leg
bespoke_layers.reason: 593 child-key legs are pure literals naming a column-as-instance inside a pivot view. The unpivot layer must fan one parent row into N instance rows keyed by the LEG LITERAL, which has no source column to unpivot from - the literal IS the instance name. 39 of these legs carry no 'expression' field at all and the generator must synthesise the quoted literal from 'value'.

name_injectivity_note: Re-proved this run: the 44-entry abbreviation vocabulary applied to all 115 views needing a cast yields 115 DISTINCT names, 0 collisions, longest 41 characters against Snowflake's 63-character identifier limit, and 0 names over 63. The longest source view name is 138 characters, so the abbreviation is not optional.

child_key_leg_hazards.synthesis_rule: For the 44 literal legs the generator must synthesise a quoted SQL literal from `value`; there is no expression to copy.

PROSE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_A_VALUE_FIELD.value: '<not on this view - no media / document identifier on this view>'
PROSE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_A_VALUE_FIELD.why: The ONE leg whose leg_backing is `unresolved` carries no expression and a `value` that is an ALREADY-QUOTED English sentence. A generator that synthesises a literal from `value` - which is the correct rule for the other 44 - writes that sentence into the child key. It must be refused at build time as a sentinel, not rendered. This leg is also one of the 20 collapse traps.

build_directives.directive_note: The separator-degeneration guard is ALREADY IN THE MAP on all 185 degenerating concats and it fires. The build must copy it through and must not add a second one.
build_directives.mechanism: Emit resolved_key.expression and child_key_components[].expression verbatim. Assert as a gate that every concat which evaluates to a non-empty constant on an all-blank row is enclosed by a nullif whose second operand equals that constant - the same probe used here, reusable as a build-side check.

build_directives.directive_note: Do NOT normalise either hash-operand guard idiom. Both are correct in context and the mapper has asked twice that they be left alone.
build_directives.mechanism: Copy content-hash expressions through unchanged; add NO coalesce-placement rewrite rule anywhere in the generator chain.

build_directives.directive_note: normalise(x) = collapse_internal_whitespace(upper(trim(x))), NULL in NULL out, applied to the whole concatenation and NOT per component. It KEEPS the empty slot rather than dropping nulls before concat.
build_directives.mechanism: One function in mtv2_keyrules.py emitting upper + trim + regexp_replace(x,'\\s+',' '). Never substitute a hash whose NULL handling differs. Implement md5(NULL) -> NULL explicitly rather than relying on the warehouse.

build_directives.directive_note: A second, undeclared canonicalisation exists on the 'NOMINEE:' party keys. upper+trim does not collapse internal whitespace, so it is NOT the same key space as normalise.
build_directives.mechanism: Emit those 10 verbatim as mapped - changing them would re-key a hub on my own authority - and raise the divergence to the mapper. Record the two canonicalisations in BUILD_STATUS.json so the split is visible.

build_directives.directive_note: Resolve an abbreviated spine destination ONLY against the start view's own ancestor chain, longest matching prefix wins; if a token still matches more than one ancestor, STOP.
build_directives.mechanism: The resolver takes the start view, walks parent_table_candidate from 00_tables_index.json and matches suffixes on that chain only. Verified here to resolve all 297 abbreviated hops with 0 ambiguity and 0 misses.

build_directives.directive_note: The spine operator is an LCA cross, not a climb. 2 arrows reach a sibling.
build_directives.mechanism: Resolve every hop as lowest-common-ancestor; a climb-only resolver silently returns nothing for PREMIUM_DETAILS -> POLICY_DETAILS and the miss reads as a source gap.

build_directives.directive_note: 787 of 5496 arrows skip 1 to 4 levels; every intervening view must be expanded into the join chain.
build_directives.mechanism: Expand each hop through the parent chain before emitting joins. This is what makes 14 of the 51 walk-only casts necessary; sizing the cast layer from named destinations alone under-builds it.

build_directives.directive_note: A link leg must be byte-identical to the key of the hub it references; a disagreeing leg produces an empty join, which reads as sparse source data rather than an error.
build_directives.mechanism: 25 of 51 LNK call sites are POSITIONAL and 11 have a single leg, so leg identity CANNOT be recovered from a name on those. Match each leg's expression STRING against the set of hub key expressions resolved on the same view (BUILD_RULES.md 4). Assert every LNK leg string appears verbatim as some hub's resolved_key.expression on that view; raise on any that does not.

build_directives.directive_note: Build HUB_RISK_OBJECT in the QUALIFIED <root>#POL_RISK_ID form and expect TWO namespaces ('RISK:' 215 rows, 'TRIP:' 12) until the source answers. Unchanged by this re-issue - verified identical old and new.
build_directives.mechanism: Isolate the '#' qualifier in ONE function so a source answer drops it across all 210 rows in a single edit. Count rows per namespace prefix into BUILD_STATUS.json.

build_directives.directive_note: Do NOT collapse SAT_POLICY_DOCUMENT_DISPATCH (11 rows) into SAT_POLICY_DELIVERY.
build_directives.mechanism: Build them as two satellites. SAT_POLICY_DELIVERY is single-active SCD2 on HUB_POLICY; the dispatch source is a depth-2 shred child and all 11 rows declare multi_active with child key 'Dispatch Serial Number'.

build_directives.directive_note: The mapper declares the SERIAL_NO child key a positional ordinal and a source gap, but did NOT re-key it. The build receives an unstable child-key leg.
build_directives.mechanism: Build the 11 rows as mapped, and emit the declaration into BUILD_STATUS.json as a known-unstable child key. Do NOT silently substitute POD_NUMBER - the mapper named it a candidate, not a decision (BUILD_RULES.md 5.7).

build_directives.directive_note: 39 augmentation rows declare a compound child key and supply only some of its legs - e.g. SAT_POLICY_PREMIUM_HEAD declares 4 legs and 5 rows supply 1. Rows sharing the supplied legs collide on the missing ones.
build_directives.mechanism: Do not invent the missing legs. Within one satellite the child key must be ONE leg set; SAT_POLICY_PREMIUM_HEAD currently carries three different sets across its rows. Build only the rows that supply the satellite's full declared set and list the rest in accepted_uncovered.txt with the mapper's own 'declared, NOT invented' wording.

build_directives.directive_note: 2 rows on SAT_CLAIM_EVIDENCE carry a child_key_value that names no leg while the satellite declares 2 legs; the mapper refused to guess the pairing.
build_directives.mechanism: Leave both unbuilt; accepted_uncovered with the mapper's reason.

build_directives.bundle_item: STAGE-0 finding on the 281 emitted components
build_directives.directive_note: Augmentation multi-active rows with a rendering-only child key fell 283 -> 2. Nothing in the build may parse child_key_value prose.
build_directives.mechanism: Read child_key_components[] only. If a generator branch exists that parses child_key_value, delete it - it now has 2 live inputs and both are declared gaps.

build_directives.directive_note: Seven source column names begin with a digit (1ST_REMINDER_DATE, 2ND_REMINDER_DATE, 3RD_REMINDER_DATE, 64_VB_STATUS).
build_directives.mechanism: Double-quote every source column identifier in emitted SQL. An unquoted 1ST_REMINDER_DATE is a Snowflake syntax error that the static gates will not catch because dbt is out of scope.

build_directives.directive_note: OPUS's contract on its 12 SAT_AUG_* satellites is absolute: single-active, no child key, bare HASHDIFF, src_pk a HUB key - including the two LNK_-named ones, which key on PARTY_HKEY, not a link key.
build_directives.mechanism: Emit the 94 same-concept rows into the OPUS-named SAT_AUG_<X> under OPUS's contract. The 16 SAT_PARTY_BANKING rows that declare multi-active CANNOT be honoured as multi-active without breaking that contract - build them single-active and raise the grain divergence (see open item AUG-GRAIN-BANKING).

build_directives.directive_note: The single leg_backing='unresolved' leg carries a quoted prose sentinel in `value` and no expression.
build_directives.mechanism: Treat leg_backing=unresolved as a HARD SENTINEL: refuse the row at build time and report it as an unbuilt item, never synthesise a literal from its `value`.

build_directives.directive_note: 297 abbreviated spine destinations, of which PARTY_PROPERTY (145 hops) matches two tables globally.
build_directives.mechanism: Resolve an abbreviated destination ONLY against the start view's own ancestor chain, longest matching prefix. Verified to resolve all 297 uniquely; resolved globally, 67 hops cross from the proposer branch into the member branch.

build_directives.directive_note: A link leg must equal the key of the hub it references.
build_directives.mechanism: Emit the hub key expression for the leg by construction, so the two cannot diverge. 7 value-changing divergences exist in the map today.

build_directives.directive_note: degenerate_value is JSON null on all 2344 blocks and degenerate_verdict is 'null_on_blank_row' on all 2344. The field is executable again: a generator may now read it. It carries exactly one of three tokens and only one of the three occurs.
build_directives.mechanism: Read degenerate_verdict, not degenerate_value, and not the CSV's `verdict` column (different vocabulary). Build the null_on_blank_row branch - reject the row. Make empty_on_blank_row and constant_on_blank_row RAISE, because this bundle contains zero examples of either and an untested branch that silently writes a key is the defect the whole contract exists to prevent.

build_directives.directive_note: The generated census covers only resolved_key.expression (2344). The build executes 3418 live expressions; the other 1074 are child_key_components[].expression and they are NOT policed by the allowlist.
build_directives.mechanism: Use the ALL-LIVE figures (trim 5094 / nullif 5084 / coalesce 1783 / spine[] 2390 / md5 138 / normalise 128 / lnk 51 / upper 19) in any build-side assertion, and add a build-side allowlist check that sweeps BOTH expression fields. Report the gap to the mapper rather than editing their script.

build_directives.bundle_item: Workbook 'Key Derivations' sheet, column 'Degenerate Value (all-blank row)'
build_directives.directive_note: Now empty on all 2366 rows and the workbook carries no verdict column at all.
build_directives.mechanism: Do not read the workbook for the degenerate contract. The map is the only artifact that carries the machine token.

build_directives.bundle_item: Source column names 1ST_/2ND_/3RD_REMINDER_DATE and 64_VB_STATUS (21 row instances)
build_directives.directive_note: Four source column names begin with a digit and are not legal bare SQL identifiers.
build_directives.mechanism: Quote every source column reference in generated SQL unconditionally, rather than special-casing these four.
